mapper.select: SELECT cbr.id, cbr.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, cbr.behavior_type, cbr.behavior_name, cbr.behavior_value, cbr.carbon_reduction, cbr.points, cbr.description, cbr.proof_image, cbr.audit_status, CASE cbr.audit_status WHEN 0 THEN '待审核' WHEN 1 THEN '审核通过' WHEN 2 THEN '审核拒绝' END AS audit_status_text, cbr.audit_user_id, au.username AS audit_user_name, cbr.audit_time, cbr.audit_remark, cbr.create_time FROM carbon_behavior_record cbr LEFT JOIN user u ON cbr.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user au ON cbr.audit_user_id = au.id WHERE cbr.id = #{id}
